name: soundwave_app.com
description: A free music streaming platform with web and mobile support

scripts.dev: node scripts/update-env-ip.js && node node_modules/concurrently/bin/concurrently.js "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/update-env-ip.js && cd web-frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:mobile: node scripts/update-env-ip.js && cd mobile-app && npm run start
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm run build:mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:backend && npm run test:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:backend

author: Ujwal8156v
